title: Kononenkogroup media
description: A flat, square-cornered media frame for photos and drawings; empty, it is a pale muted placeholder surface at the given size and aspect.
notes: give the frame its size or aspect through className
name: kononenkogroup-media

props.name: media
props.description:
the image or video; it should fill the frame (e.g. an img with w-full h-full object-cover).
Empty: a flat placeholder surface of the same size

props.name: className
props.description: size and aspect of the frame, e.g. "aspect-[8/5]"
